# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.7.1 - 2026-11-05

- First version: BoldDesk remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- Endpoint and tools taken from the BoldDesk MCP Server documentation. The endpoint is per account, so you enter your BoldDesk host when you install.
- The auth mode is OAuth 2.0 (dynamic client registration).
- Clarified that the host must be the full host name.
- OAuth 2.0 is the only sign-in method the plugin offers. The API key option is removed.
